findings.title: Working-hours check compares the slot start with itself, so `end` is always equal to `start`
findings.body: `const end = slotStartTime.hour() * 60 + slotStartTime.minute();` is identical to `start`. It should presumably use `slotEndTime`. The check also treats a slot as unavailable if `start < startTime || end > endTime`. That uses the UTC clock of the slot against working hours that may be in other units or timezones, and a slot that ends after `workingHour.endTime` is never rejected. Also, `find` returns true as soon as any single working-hour entry for that day does not contain the slot, so a user with two disjoint ranges on a day (e.g. 9-12 and 14-18) is treated as unavailable for every slot. This will wrongly remove slots.

findings.title: Dead comparison between Dayjs objects using `===`
findings.body: `dayjs(date.start).add(...) === dayjs(date.end).add(...)` compares two distinct object references, so it is always false. The intended zero-length-override check never fires and the code is misleading. It should use `.isSame()` or be removed.

findings.title: Date override matching in checkIfIsAvailable uses an inverted/ambiguous offset and compares dates in UTC
findings.body: The offset is computed as `dayjs.tz(date.start, organizerTimeZone).utcOffset() * -1` and added to the UTC override start. That shifts the override into the opposite direction from the organizer's local time. The shifted date is then compared by `YYYY MM DD` string with the slot's UTC date. With an override on a day boundary or non-UTC organizer, this matches the wrong day, so `dateOverrideExist` is set for the wrong slots or not set for the right ones. The `slotStartTime.isAfter(end)` check also lets a slot that starts before the override end but runs past it be accepted. Slots that would exceed the override window are not rejected. The override detection ignores the slot's end entirely.

findings.title: Override on the day short-circuits busy-time checks
findings.body: When `dateOverrideExist` is true the function does `return true` and never reaches the `busy.every(...)` check. A fixed host with a date override on that day will therefore be reported as available for every slot inside the override, even when they have a booking or calendar event at that time. This causes double bookings on override days. It should fall through to the busy check.

findings.title: Override offset computed from `override.start.toString()` and may be wrong or undefined timezone
findings.body: `dayjs(override.start.toString())` parses a locale-formatted Date string, which loses milliseconds and depends on parsing the local-string format; `.toISOString()` or `dayjs(override.start)` is safer. `override.timeZone` is optional in the type; if it is undefined, `.tz(undefined)` falls back to the system/default timezone and gives a wrong offset. The shifted `hour()*60+minute()` of the start/end also wraps around midnight when the offset pushes the time into another day, so an end time of e.g. 23:00 plus offset becomes 04:30 and is less than start, which `buildSlots` drops as invalid.

findings.title: Active overrides are still filtered by the unshifted UTC start while times are shifted afterwards
findings.body: The filter `dayjs.utc(override.start).isBetween(startOfInviteeDay, ...)` selects overrides by their raw UTC start, but the new offset adjustment is applied afterwards. An override whose shifted time falls on the invitee's day but whose UTC start falls on the adjacent day is excluded or placed on the wrong day. This is a mismatch between selection and conversion.

findings.title: Timezone test asserts identical slots and does not test the fixed-host round-robin fix
findings.body: The new test for `Asia/Dhaka` expects the same UTC slots as for Kolkata. That passes trivially because the result is in UTC and does not verify that the override is shifted per invitee timezone. The PR's primary fix, date overrides of fixed hosts in round-robin events, has no test at all. The `toHaveTimeSlots` helper also only iterates over actual slots, so extra or missing expected slots are not detected.
